queries:
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, eq.avg_hum - overall.overall_avg AS exceed
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_mean FROM above
)
SELECT a.equipref,
       a.avg_hum AS avg_humidity,
       a.exceed AS exceeds_overall_avg,
       a.avg_hum - g.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above a, grp g, overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean IS NULL, diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS a
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS o
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.humepct) AS g
  FROM scanenvironment s
  JOIN eq ON s.equipref = eq.equipref
  CROSS JOIN overall
  WHERE eq.a > overall.o
)
SELECT eq.equipref,
       eq.a AS avg_humidity,
       eq.a - overall.o AS diff_from_overall,
       eq.a - grp.g AS diff_from_group
FROM eq
CROSS JOIN overall
CROSS JOIN grp
WHERE eq.a > overall.o
  AND overall.o IS NOT NULL
  AND grp.g IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS all_avg FROM eq
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, overall.all_avg
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.all_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(se.humepct) AS group_mean
  FROM scanenvironment se
  WHERE se.equipref IN (SELECT equipref FROM above)
)
SELECT a.equipref,
       a.avg_hum AS avg_humidity,
       a.avg_hum - a.all_avg AS exceeds_all_avg,
       a.avg_hum - g.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above a, grp g
WHERE a.all_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
WITH per_equip AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_hum, o.overall_avg, p.avg_hum - o.overall_avg AS exceeds
  FROM per_equip p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_hum > o.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_mean
  FROM above
)
SELECT a.equipref,
       a.avg_hum AS avg_humidity,
       a.exceeds AS exceeds_overall_avg,
       a.avg_hum - g.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above a
CROSS JOIN grp g
WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
